text:
maria: Quick idea — add a small live "peek" in Console saved-query rows that shows per-route quota burn + active model fallback tier. useful when you want to save a query for a route but also see if it'll blow past monthly commit. :thinking_face:
jess: Love that. Visuals? inline pill: "12k/50k tokens (24%) • fallback: gpt-like-small" with hover for recent spikes. click to expand to 1h / 24h sparklines. :sparkles:
deepak: Backend note: we currently store per-route token counters at 1m granularity in metrics. To render hover details we'd need a small API to fetch rolling aggregates + current fallback mapping. Should be fine but must respect telemetry sample rates — some routes are sampled 1% only.
arun: If the route is sampled low, we should show an explicit confidence meta (e.g., ~3% sampled -> estimated). Also we need to show cost-estimate delta if saved-query adds a model change (eg switching from base->quantized). otherwise people misinterpret.
maria: exact. UX idea: two-line microsummary in list: first line quota with percent, second line small row: "model: rtv-m-1 (active) -> fallback: rtv-m-0 (on overflow)". click to open modal with runbook + quick change for route presets.
jess: mockup attached later, but small ask: keep row height minimal. maybe show only icon + tooltip on hover and expand on click.
deepak: API contract proposal: GET /routes/:id/peek?window=1h returns {tokens_used, capacity, fallback_variant, sampling_rate, estimate_confidence}. We need to include a boolean "is_estimate" when sampling < 10%.
arun: Also attach last-deploy model tag so we can surface if saved query recommends a different pinned model. Save query flow should allow "preview cost per-run" before saving.
maria: Can the peek request be cheap? we want it to load when list renders ~50 rows.
deepak: We'll rate-limit and multi-get. Backend can return cached peek for 30s; cold queries cost 2 DB reads. For 50 rows with caching it's fine. I'll add a circuit-breaker if more than 100 concurrent peek calls from a user.
jess: Behaviour on routing fallback rules? Suppose route has canary -> dedicated -> hosted fallbacks. Peek should show the active tier and next fallback in order. UI: 3-dot mini breadcrumb.
arun: Telemetry: emit an event when users click the peek expand so we can track adoption and whether the preview reduces saves that would exceed quota. Add tag: preview_variant_recommendation_shown.
maria: Ops question — what should ops-bot post if peek shows >95% of committed tokens for the month?
ops-bot: incident-bot: ROUTE QUOTA WARNING: route "payments/authorize" is at 96% of committed tokens this billing window. Recommended actions: reduce sampling, enable caching/prefix, set fallback to cheaper variant. :warning:
deepak: Let's add an inline CTA in the modal: "Create temporary quota override" (only visible to admins) that creates a one-off commit bump and logs the change.
arun: Permissions + audit: creating override should create an audit log entry and trigger a Slack pm to finance.
maria: Ok next steps: Jess — rough mockup this week. Deepak — draft API PR + perf numbers for 50/200 row lists. Arun — telemetry event plan + sampling confidence strings. I'll sync with product-review Friday. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
